summary: Iteration 49 — Frontend-only verification of the two new features on top of iterations 47/48: (1) Level Change Note in FrameworkPanel and (2) Organization resource library with 'ORG' vs 'MY LIBRARY' framework badges. Seeded a complete court-referred flow via /app/backend/tests/seed_iter49.py (judge referral → pro accept → both parents complete → statement ready score 3 → submit-to-court v1; pro's profile.organization set to 'Alamo Test Org'; colleague pro created with same org lowercased; stranger pro with no org). Extra completed cases for colleague and stranger were created via /app/backend/tests/seed_iter49_extra.py. Drove every scenario through the preview URL with Playwright. Scenario A (level change): opened /joint/{rid} as the pro — no level-change-note-box initially; moved framework-slider to score 6 → box appeared with 'Level changed from 3 to 6'; clicking statement-mark-ready-btn returned a 400 and the visible error toast contained 'changed from 3 to 6'; filling level-change-note then Mark ready → success; ticking submit-attest and clicking submit-to-court-btn (dialog auto-accepted) surfaced 'version 2' in the UI and court-submissions-list shows submission-level-2 = 'Level 6/10'. Judge check: logged in as the judge and opened /court/case/{refId} → court-level-history-2 is present and court-level-note-2 reads 'From Level 3: Parents completed two facilitated sessions; written-only scheduling in use.'. Scenario B (org library): resource-library-toggle → resource-library-tab-org → org-library-note mentions 'Alamo Test Org'; adding 'Shared county clinic' via org-library-input-resources + org-library-add-resources produced the 'Organization library saved' toast; framework-group-resources listed the item with framework-library-badge-resources='ORG'. Adding 'My private class' via resource-library-tab-mine produced a MY LIBRARY badge alongside the ORG one. Colleague (org 'alamo test org', lowercase) on their own ready case sees 'Shared county clinic' with ORG badge and org-library-note case-insensitively references the org. Stranger (no org) sees org-library-missing under the org tab and no 'Shared county clinic' in the framework. Regression: /samples/education loaded (2670 chars body), landing / renders (contains 'Align'). Total 22/22 assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: FrameworkPanel: levelChanged uses `lastSubmittedScore && lastSubmittedScore !== score` — if the very first submission had score === 0 the note box would never trigger, but dynamic_score validation guarantees >=1 so acceptable.
ResourceLibrary: LibraryEditor's inputs are keyed only by group; typing in one input while switching tabs preserves the drafts state which is fine, and the enter-key add path is wired.
CourtCase renders court-level-note-{v} only when both `h.changed_from` and `h.note` are truthy — matches the spec (only shown for level changes).
